messages:
omar: Seeing recurring ETL lag that correlates with spikes in aggregator window finalization. This has caused nightly metrics to be ~4% low for the last 5 days. Opening thread to assign owners and timeline.

jill: do we have a reproducible window or sample trace ids?

omar: sample window: hourly-2026-03-25-03. Raw span store shows late arrivals 20-90m after event time.

karen: infra saw elevated consumer rebalances that align with those windows. likely caused by autoscaler churn during cpu pressure.

mike: quick mitigation: extend finalization grace for hourly windows to 90m. I can flip feature flag and run canary. Owner: mike. ETA: 2h.

karen: I'll look at the autoscaler policy and add a cooldown to prevent thrash. Owner: karen. ETA: EOD.

jill: we need a reconciliation job to compare aggregator indices to raw spans and emit backfill tasks. Owner: jill + omar. ETA: design spike 3 days.

omar: ops-bot: create a ticket and schedule a weekly follow-up for 4 weeks.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-4756: "Nightly metrics gap due to late-arriving spans during autoscaler churn" and added weekly follow-ups. Assigned to @mike, @karen, @jill.

mike: canary started at 05:10 UTC on 5% traffic. monitoring span-completeness and finalize-errors.

karen: autoscaler logs: scaled-down group at 03:02, then scaled-up at 03:04; consumer rebalances observed at 03:03 three times.

mike: canary 5% -> 25% -> full rollout completed at 06:12 UTC. No regressions observed.

jill: starting reconciliation spike: pulling diffs for last 48h, will submit backfill jobs if >0.5% delta.

omar: recap action items: - mike: finalize-grace flag + monitoring (done) - karen: autoscaler cooldown & GC review (EOD) - jill/omar: reconciliation design + spike (3 days) - omar: postmortem note + runbook update (tomorrow noon)

mike: added alert: finalize.missing_spans > 1% for 30m -> page oncall.

jill: spike produced 2 backfill jobs restoring ~1.9% of spans; will prod this week if stable.

omar: closing active work here; will update INFR-4756 with links to dashboards and runbook. Comment here if regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
